Cinder Hounds

Cinder hounds prowl the ash fields, following the smell of smoke for miles.

Cinder Hound

Medium elemental, unaligned

Armor Class 14 (natural armor)

Hit Points 32 (5d8 + 10)

Speed 40 ft.

STR 15 (+2) DEX 14 (+2) CON 14 (+2) INT 3 (-4) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 6 (-2)

Challenge 1 (200 XP)

Actions

Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) fire damage.

Ash Lantern

Wondrous item, uncommon

This lantern sheds dim light in a 20-foot radius and never goes out.
